_comment: Copy to $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/ttrpg-transcriber/config.json (usually ~/.config/ttrpg-transcriber/config.json) and edit. Set either 'vaults_root' (a directory holding one vault per world; campaigns become <world>/<campaign>) or 'vault' (a single vault). Neither has a default because there is no correct guess; if both are set, vaults_root wins. Every other key is optional and shown here with its default or an example. 'whisper_device' is whisper-cli's -dev index and only matters with more than one GPU: use the number ggml prints at startup. 'python' is the interpreter that has chromadb and sentence-transformers installed; only Index, info and query use it. Environment variables win over this file: GM_VAULTS_ROOT, GM_VAULT, GM_AUDIO_ROOT, GM_CHROMA_ROOT, GM_WORK_ROOT, GM_CAMPAIGNS_SUBDIR, GM_TRANSCRIPTS_SUBDIR, GM_WHISPER_BIN, GM_WHISPER_MODEL, GM_WHISPER_DEVICE, GM_WHISPER_MC, GM_PYTHON, GM_STOCK_PHRASES, GM_STOCK_MIN_SECONDS, GM_IGNORE_WORDS. Run 'ttrpg-tui doctor' to see what resolved and where each value came from.
